ai.ex.1: Which folders take up the most space on drive D?
ai.ex.2: Summarize what's in my Downloads folder
ai.ex.3: Read me this project folder's description
ai.ex.4: Which files in the reports folder are still in review?
ai.ex.5: Show free space and index status for my drives
an.downloads.tip: Find installers you already used, duplicates, archives you already extracted and old files in Downloads
an.logs.tip: Pack old *.log files on this drive into monthly zips to save space
an.ownSize.tip: Sort by the files directly in each folder, excluding subfolders (no double counting)
an.reanalyze.tip: With the index service this takes seconds without rereading the disk
an.rebuildable.tip: Find rebuildable folders such as node_modules, bin/obj, __pycache__, __history and .git in the current folder, largest first (only what you choose goes to the Recycle Bin)
an.suggest.hint: Only rebuildable folders and old files are suggested. System folders such as Windows and Program Files never are. [To Recycle Bin] moves items to the Recycle Bin, it does not delete them permanently.
an.system.hint: System files such as Windows Update files, thumbnails and previous Windows installations are safest to clean with Windows itself.
pane.cmd.tip: Open this folder in Command Prompt (Ctrl+click: admin)
pane.git.commit.tip: Choose changed files in the Git view and commit them
pane.git.open.tip: Commit history, diffs and committing in one view
pane.git.pull.tip: Merges new commits from the remote repository into your branch
pane.git.push.tip: Sends your commits to the remote repository
pane.ps.tip: Open this folder in PowerShell (Ctrl+`) · Ctrl+click: admin
pane.sftp.tip: Connect to an SFTP server (Ctrl+Shift+O): pick a saved server or add a new one
pane.slow.tip: This drive responds slowly, so previews, thumbnails and Git detection are reduced
pane.ssh.tip: SSH terminal on the same server, account and folder (Ctrl+`)
pane.tags.clear.tip: Removes the tags from this folder's files (the files stay)
pane.tags.next.tip: Go to the next file not yet marked 'done' (Ctrl+D toggles done)
pane.tags.share.tip: Whether tags are committed to the Git repository (off by default: kept only in this PC's folder)
set.accent.hint: The retro theme keeps its own colors.
set.ai.hint: If an AI app such as Claude is installed but not yet connected to Foldy, a one-line note appears when Foldy starts. You can connect any time from More → AI connection (MCP).
set.ai.suggest: Suggest connecting when an AI app is installed
set.animations.hint: Turning this off removes the basketball animation and screen motion. Foldy also follows Windows' 'reduce animation' setting.
set.channel.hint: The beta channel gets versions before their official release. They may be unstable.
set.cleanupNotices.hint: Checked lightly using the index; you get a one-line note only when there's a lot to tidy (at most once a week). Nothing is deleted automatically.
set.cleanupNotices.on: Tell me when logs or downloads pile up
set.copyThreads.auto: Automatic copy threads (tuned to the drives involved)
set.copyThreads.hint: 1 to 64. More threads are usually faster between SSDs; fewer are usually faster for HDDs and network drives.
set.crash.hint: Personal data such as paths and file names is removed before sending. You can turn this off any time.
set.crash.on: Send error reports automatically (duplicates grouped, paths and user names removed)
set.desktopSuggest: Suggest tidying at startup when the desktop or Downloads has more than 20 files
set.gitBar.hint: In Git repository folders, shows the branch, change count and pull/push buttons above the file list.
set.keys.conflict: Some commands share a shortcut. Only the first one runs.
set.keys.record: Click and press a new shortcut (Esc cancels, Backspace clears)
set.preview.sample: Foldy settings Aa 123 The quick brown fox
set.rebuildable.hint: Folder names to add to the default list (node_modules, bin/obj, target, __pycache__, .venv, dist/build, __history, .git…), separated by commas
set.rebuildable.hint2: Added names are matched by name alone, even without a project file next to them. Found folders go to the Recycle Bin only after you choose them.
set.rebuildable.name: Folder names to add
set.slowCrawl: Gently gather drives without an index (network drives, Google Drive, etc.)
set.slowCrawl.hint: While Foldy is running it opens folders one at a time to gather file lists. It slows down on slow drives and pauses during jobs like copying. The list stays on this PC and is searchable with Ctrl+Space and Ctrl+F.
set.title: Foldy settings
set.versions.hint: When a copy or move in Foldy overwrites a file, the original is kept on the same drive for 7 days (up to 2 GB per drive). Right-click the file → Previous versions to restore it.
set.versions.on: Keep the previous version before overwriting (7 days)
set.wtProfile.admin: Profile name for an admin terminal
set.wtProfile.hint: Leave empty to use Windows Terminal's default profile. Available profiles:
set.wtProfile.normal: Profile name for a normal terminal
settings.language.hint: Takes effect the next time Foldy starts. Translation is in progress, so only part of Foldy is translated yet.
shell.bin.empty.name: Empty Recycle Bin
shell.bin.empty.tip: Empty Recycle Bin (permanent, cannot be restored)
shell.bin.tip: Open the Windows Recycle Bin (restore deleted files)
shell.diag.tip: Bug diagnostics is on (detailed logging). Click to turn it off and choose whether to send the log
shell.find.name: Search file names
shell.find.quick: Quick search (files, apps, settings, features, math)
shell.group.find.tip: File search, folder analysis, compare panes, images only
shell.group.protect.tip: Locked notes, password protection, vault, Recycle Bin
shell.group.tidy.tip: Tidy this folder, templates, folder methods, desktop/downloads/log cleanup
shell.more.tip: All commands, theme, hidden files, updates, bug report, about and more
shell.pin.empty: Use the pin button to pin the current folder.
shell.sidebar.collapse.tip: Collapse sidebar (Ctrl+Shift+B) · or drag its right edge
shell.splitter.panes: Drag to resize the two panes
shell.splitter.sidebar: Drag to resize the sidebar (very narrow shows icons only)
shell.tidy.method: Choose how to manage this folder…
shell.tidy.rebuildable: Find folders safe to delete (in this folder)…
side.find.tip: Files, apps, Windows settings and Foldy features in one box (Ctrl+Space anywhere)
side.space.tip: Folder analysis: see what takes up space and remove only what is safe to delete
side.template.tip: Preview and create a folder structure such as PARA or industry project phases in one go (Ctrl+Shift+N)
side.tidy.tip: Tidy helper: choose where and how, and see the result before anything moves (nothing is deleted, and you can undo)
suggest.ai: Ask {0} "{1}" and Foldy finds it on your PC. Read-only.
suggest.desktop: There are {0} files on your desktop. Shall I sort them by type? Nothing is deleted, and you can undo.
suggest.downloads: There are {0} files in Downloads. Shall I pick out installers you already used and duplicates?
tagline: A fast, smart file manager, even offline
tagline.sub: Even easier when connected to AI

tour.git.t: Git shows up in project folders
tour.junk.s: node_modules, bin, __history… · .git gets a warning · restore from the Recycle Bin
tour.junk.t: Build leftovers, largest first, in one go
tour.memo.t: Keep passwords in a locked note
tour.para.s: See the result first · finished projects go to Archives · you can undo
tour.para.t: Even a messy folder into the four PARA boxes
tour.qs.s: 0.003 s even across 2.17 million files · Enter to open
tour.qs.t: Ctrl+Space anywhere, found as you type
tour.qs2.s: Type 'disp' for Display settings · launch apps by name
tour.qs3.s: 10 ft = 3.048 m · Enter copies the result
tour.qs4.s: 'tidy my downloads' → the Foldy feature starts right away
